Baby dies while camping; police investigating cause

A three-month-old baby girl has died while camping with her family in woodland in Staffordshire, England. Police were called to the scene on Tuesday morning and are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death, which they are currently treating as unexplained. Emergency services attended, but the baby was pronounced dead at the scene. The Independent and Metro reported the baby was three months old. The Daily Mirror also reported the incident, noting tributes were paid to a 'lovely, funny' teen who died suddenly on holiday in Portugal, though this appears to be a separate event.
